create_TransformerEncoder: create a TransformerEncoder that wraps a BERT model for encoding input tokens into hidden representations
run_TransformerEncoder_forward: run the TransformerEncoder forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask to get BERT hidden states
create_EncoderDecoder: create an EncoderDecoder module that combines an encoder and decoder for back translation tasks
run_EncoderDecoder_forward: run the EncoderDecoder forward pass with source tokens, target tokens, masks, and labels for training
run_EncoderDecoder_step: run the EncoderDecoder step method for inference without computing loss using encoder representations
